description_first_lines: Pulse: See what Windows is really doing Pulse is the Windows diagnostic app that finally translates your computer’s crash logs into plain English. Instead of staring at cryptic error codes and XML files, it watches your system in real time and explains exactly what went wrong in simple sentences. It tells you if Windows restarted after a blue screen, if a specific driver failed, or if a power loss occurred, turning confusing technical noise into clear, readable insights. It also shows your CPU, memory, and disk usage in a live view, so you can see exactly what your machine is doing right now.
